# Plain Tunnel Guide

> An independent guide to Proton VPN: what the free plan covers, what VPN Plus costs and renews at, and how to install it, written from the company's own pages.

Independent guides to Proton VPN by Plain Tunnel Guide. Facts come from the vendor's pages on the date shown on each page.

## Decide
- [Proton VPN review: a free plan that works and a paid plan built for privacy](https://proton-pc.github.io/review.html): Proton VPN review from the vendor's documentation: free plan limits, VPN Plus features, Secure Core, NetShield, prices from $2.99 a month, an 8.6/10 score.
- [Proton VPN pricing: VPN Plus and Unlimited prices, renewals and offers](https://proton-pc.github.io/pricing.html): Proton VPN pricing checked 26 November 2026: VPN Plus $9.99 a month or $2.99 a month for the first year, renewals at $83.88, Unlimited, payment and refunds.
- [Proton VPN free vs Plus: what the free plan leaves out](https://proton-pc.github.io/free-vs-plus.html): Proton VPN free vs Plus compared: 1 device vs 10, 10 random countries vs 140+, streaming, P2P and NetShield, and the features both plans share.
- [Proton VPN refund and cancellation: the 30 day guarantee explained](https://proton-pc.github.io/refund-cancel.html): Proton VPN refund policy: 30 day money back on all paid plans, cancel any time, prorated plan changes, renewal prices to watch and where the full terms are.

## Do it
- [Download Proton VPN: what you get, supported systems and install steps](https://proton-pc.github.io/download.html): Download Proton VPN from the official site: free plan or VPN Plus, x64 and ARM64 Windows builds, supported platforms, install steps and the 30 day refund.
- [How to set up Proton VPN on Windows, step by step](https://proton-pc.github.io/setup-windows.html): Set up Proton VPN on Windows: pick the x64 or ARM64 build, install, sign in, use Quick Connect, turn on the kill switch and fix connection problems.
- [Proton VPN system requirements and supported devices](https://proton-pc.github.io/devices.html): Proton VPN system requirements: Windows x64 and ARM64, macOS, Ubuntu and Debian, Android, iOS, TVs and browsers, plus device limits and router setup.

## Compare
- [Proton VPN alternatives: the rivals the company compares itself with](https://proton-pc.github.io/alternatives.html): Proton VPN alternatives: NordVPN, ExpressVPN, Surfshark, CyberGhost, Mullvad and Private Internet Access, with the claims from the vendor's own table.
